errors.description: irq_vector_q is a multi-bit value produced in periph_clk and sampled directly in cpu_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
irq_pulse_q is a one-cycle periph_clk pulse consumed directly in cpu_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
irq_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample cpu_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in cpu_event_o.
priority_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector priority_q before decoding in cpu_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
periph_rst_n is used as data inside cpu_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
debug_snapshot_q combines periph_clk payload state with cpu_clk status state in debug_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
